nodes.author: ThailandMedicaX
nodes.text: One of the most striking findings was that pediatric airway cells had a much higher viral load of HMPV compared to adult cells. This suggests that HMPV replicates more efficiently in children, which may explain why younger patients often experience more severe symptoms
